sources.note: Nothing. 5.1.0 (pp. 283-284) gives vowel and consonant tables, nasal contrast only for u and a, 'Долгота не фонематична' (length not phonemic), falling vowel sequences, syllable types (C)V etc; 5.1.2 'Вопрос о типах чередований в Б.я. не изучен'. sources.note: The only full modern reference grammar (304 pp) by a trained descriptive linguist; a Nepal Academy grammar of this format normally has a dhvani-vyavastha (phonology) chapter with a paragraph on balaghat/svaraghat (stress). Most likely place for an explicit stress statement.
